firm_data.firm_description: Stimpfl Manashirov & Bundschuh, PLLC is a results-driven law firm specializing in property damage, construction defect, products liability, insurance coverage disputes and subrogation litigation. Their attorneys provide representation for developers, property owners, general contractors, subcontractors, and others.
notable_facts: Handles cases in both State and Federal Courts
Represents clients in the New York City metro area, Long Island, Westchester County and Rockland County

email.subject: AI for Stimpfl Manashirov & Bundschuh, PLLC - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kevin,

Construction defect and insurance coverage disputes demand precision and speed, especially when you're handling complex litigation across State and Federal Courts. I noticed you've built that capability with a lean team since 2013, and that's exactly the profile we're seeing succeed with AI.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in your region to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by Hauppauge on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
